_meta.description: Curated rarity corrections for the B-series shiny regions. Bulbapedia/Serebii wikitext lumps shiny (8-point star) tiers into one_star/two_star, and Limitless lists them as illustration_rare, so multi-source voting converges on the wrong tier for B2b/B3/B3a. Tier boundaries derived from PZ per-card drop-chance clusters (pz_pack_odds.json), anchored on B2 Fantastical Parade (identical structure + drop values, correctly classified) and confirmed against the user's in-app per-set Star / 8-point-Star / Crown counters (2026-06-12).
_meta.applied_by: build_card_reference.py (after the SIR step); takes precedence over all source votes
